d: trapped_localize is universe polymorphic and cumulative

Over a well-containment space, 𝒯₁ (ε X) is an embedding of well-containment uniform spaces
Over a well-containment space, 𝒯 X ⇾ 𝒯 (ℒ X) is an embedding of well-containment uniform spaces

d: wc_trapped_map is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: The action 𝒯ₗ f : 𝒯 X ⇾ 𝒯 Y of the trapped completion on a morphism of well-containment spaces

d: wc_trapped_map_mor is universe polymorphic and cumulative

d: wc_trapped_map_unit is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: Naturality of the unit: 𝒯ₗ f ∘ τ X = τ Y ∘ f

d: wc_trapped_map_dense is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: If f is dense, so is the map 𝒯ₗ f : 𝒯 X ⇾ 𝒯 Y

d: wc_trapped_map is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: Local shorthand 𝒯ₗ for the trapped completion's action on morphisms of well-containment spaces
If f is an initial map of well-containment spaces, so is 𝒯ₗ f

d: wc_trapped_map_gbl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: For a global morphism f, the induced map 𝒯ₗ f equals 𝒯₁ f

d: wc_trapped_reflect is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: The reflection Z ⇾ 𝒯 X of a dense, locally reflecting map f : X ⇾ Z of well-containment spaces

d: wc_trapped_reflect_spec is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: The reflection inverts f against the unit: wc_trapped_reflect f ∘ f = τ X

d: wc_trapped_reflect_mor is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: The reflection of f is a morphism of well-containment uniform spaces

d: wc_trapped_reflect_dense is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: The reflection of f has dense range in 𝒯 X
If f is also initial, its reflection Z ⇾ 𝒯 X is an initial map of well-containment spaces

d: trapped_local_completion_reflect is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.topology.unif_born.tr.short: The local-completion operation for τ X: a dense reflecting f goes to its reflection

d: trapped_local_completion is universe polymorphic and cumulative
